messages:
amy (cs): FYI Acme legal just flagged a CVE in one of our deps and put it in their SOC2 questionnaire. They want ETA for patch, SBOM, and proof of KMS rotation by EOD. Tagging security.
jordan (sec): Thanks — can you paste the exact CVE and customer wording? Also which project/service they referenced?
amy (cs): Quote: 'CVE-2025-3101 affecting fastjson used by telemetry-collector. Please provide remediation plan, SBOM for container image, audit logs showing no external access, and KMS rotation proof.' They want an answer today.
sec-bot: Created SEC-7894 and linked to this thread: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SEC-7894
mike (eng): quick tech note — telemetry-collector image uses fastjson 1.2.48 currently. upstream patch 1.2.50 addresses the deserialization issue. We can cut a patched image and run canary.
jordan (sec): Initial triage: CVE-2025-3101 = insecure deserialization -> exploit could lead to remote code execution if untrusted JSON processed. Exposure appears limited: telemetry endpoint is internal-only (VPC) and behind auth, but still qualifies as moderate-high risk. Recommended actions: 1) patch dependency, 2) confirm no external access in logs, 3) provide SBOM, 4) optionally rotate service KMS key if required by customer.
emily (sre): I can pull audit logs for the telemetry service. Last 90-day external access query returns zero external IPs. I'll export logs and redact IPs per privacy rules. Command I will run:
```
# example gcloud logging export
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND labels.k8s-pod/app="telemetry-collector"' --limit 10000 --format json > telemetry_logs.json
```
Also for SBOM generation I'll run syft on the image:
```
syft registry.redwood/infr/telemetry-collector:sha256-abc123 -o json > sbom-telemetry.json
```
tina (legal): Acme explicitly requested KMS rotation proof as part of their checklist. They prefer a signed key version change event if we rotate. If rotation takes longer, explain why and provide timeline.
jordan (sec): Proposed customer reply (we can copy/paste): "We have triaged CVE-2025-3101 in our telemetry-collector. Planned mitigation: patch dependency to fastjson 1.2.50, canary deploy within 24-36 hours, full rollout 48-72 hours. We will provide SBOM and redacted audit logs by EOD, and KMS rotation evidence within 5 business days (or sooner if requested)." Agree?
mike (eng): I'll own the patch. Plan: open PR tonight, CI build tomorrow morning, canary deploy within 24h if CI ok. If anything blocks we'll escalate. PR link will be posted in SEC-7894.
jordan (sec): I'll write the risk statement and remediation notes for the SOC2 evidence pack and attach to SEC-7894. Also logging artifact checklist: SBOM, audit log export, deploy PR, CVE triage note.
emily (sre): Export ETA: SBOM + audit logs by EOD (today). I'll attach in the ticket and share secure link.
sec-bot: SEC-7894 severity set to P2, SLA 72h. Notifying oncall.
amy (cs): I'll respond to Acme with Jordan's proposed text and set expectation window. Offering a call also.
mike (eng): One temporary mitigation we can apply immediately: disable fastjson's default type info deserialization in config:
```
# telemetry-collector config
fastjson.disableDefaultDeserialization=true
```
This reduces risk while patch lands. I'll add config change to the PR.
jordan (sec): Good. Action items: mike -> patch + PR; emily -> SBOM + logs; jordan -> risk note + reply draft; amy -> customer comms; tina -> review legal wording if needed.
amy (cs): Thanks team — I'll send the update now and paste SEC-7894 link. :thumbsup:
mike (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/412 — CI running.
emily (sre): SBOM and logs uploaded to secure share: https://files.redwood.example/secure/SEC-7894/ (link sent to customer)
jordan (sec): I'll close the loop in the ticket after patch verification. Marking resolved once canary looks good after 24h.
amy (cs): customer replied: "Thanks — that timeline works. Please include the SBOM and the redacted audit logs in your response." I'll attach files.
mike (eng): Can confirm canary healthy after 6h; planning rollout in next maintenance window.
jordan (sec): Great. I'll add a short SOC2 evidence doc summarizing the triage, risk, mitigations, and timeline and attach to SEC-7894.
emily (sre): exported logs show only internal service accounts, no external hits. Included query in the artifact for reproducibility.
amy (cs): Closing loop with Acme now. Thanks everyone. :tada:
